{{Quote|As civilization spread through the Stennes sector, we either became prized commodities, or hunted. That is the way with humans, near or otherwise. But we are not easy prey. How can you hunt what you cannot see? Or rather, how can you hunt what you cannot help but not see?|[[Trinto Duaba/Legends|Trinto Duaba]]|<ref name="Ss" />}}
The '''Har Worlds''', also known as the '''Stennes sector''', was an [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Har Binande]], [[Rellnas]] and [[Stennaros/Legends|Stennaros]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Stennes sector was introduced in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game|roleplaying game]] source article "[[Shape-shifters]]," written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] for [[February]] [[1997]]'s [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 12|twelfth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="Ss" />

Although the Stennes sector originated from an official source,<ref name="Ss" /> [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated in [[June]] [[2015]] that its name was omitted from [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]] at the request of [[Lucasfilm]] in order to avoid confusion with the [[Stenness Node]].<ref name="Email">{{EmailCite|email=File:EAOC discussion.jpg|creator=Jason Fry|date=2015-06-30}}</ref> Instead, the Stennes sector was merged with the Har Worlds, which originated in the novel ''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''.<ref name="EAOC" />
